description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractPolicyQueryCommandStrategy' for handling policy query commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends a more general command strategy and provides a method to retrieve the previous entity tag, delegating to 'nextEntityTag'.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyQueryCommandStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a framework for handling policy query commands, allowing retrieval of previous entity tags, and serving as a superclass for specific command strategies.

methods.name: AbstractPolicyQueryCommandStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with the class type of command it handles.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an Optional<EntityTag> representing the previous entity tag associated with the command and policy, delegating to 'nextEntityTag'.
